# Welcome

Welcome to the Bristol Centre for Supercomputing (BriCS) documentation site. This site is the primary source for information on using BriCS facilities and services. Please use the site navigation menu to start browsing the site, or select one of the quick links below.

- Get started
- Read the user documentation
- Check service status
- Get Support
- View Access Terms and Policies
- Discover more on the BriCS website

BriCS is home to:

- The Isambard-AI National AI Research Resource (AIRR)
- The Isambard 3 Tier 2 Supercomputer

Along with the above, the centre is responsible for its related services, such as the BriCS Portal and BriCS Helpdesk.

Please refer to the Acknowledgements page for information on how to acknowledge use of the BriCS facilities in research outputs.
